title: Zone Defense Ball-Side Shift
description: Players in a basic zone alignment practise shifting together toward the ball side on every pass, closing gaps as a unit rather than individually.

content.objective: Shift the entire zone shape together toward the ball side on every single pass.
content.setup: Five defenders set up in a zone shape; a coach or passer moves the ball around the perimeter with no live offense yet.
instructions: As the ball moves to one side, the whole zone shifts that direction together.
Keep the zone's shape consistent — no gaps opening between defenders.
On a reversal pass, shift back the other way as one unit.
Add a post flash into the middle of the zone for the defenders to also account for.
coachingPoints: Move on the pass, not after it arrives.
Keep the defenders' spacing even as the zone shifts.
Talk constantly to stay organised as a unit.
commonMistakes: Shifting too far and leaving the weak side completely open.
One defender lagging behind the rest of the shift.
Ball-watching instead of tracking both the ball and the assignment.
content.safety: This drill has no live offense yet, so contact should not occur.
